cases.title: “Ask about this” on the Mobile tile
cases.question: What has Brad built on mobile?
cases.answer: Brad has built a range of mobile work across several roles. At Hopper, Brad co-architected and built RemoteUI, a server-driven UI framework rendered natively with Jetpack Compose and MVVM on Android and SwiftUI on iOS. At Bottle Rocket, Brad shipped native Android apps in Java and Kotlin for brands including Coca-Cola Freestyle, AskPETMD, Starwood SPG and Chewy. At Bleacher Report, Brad built and maintained Android product experiences for a high-traffic sports media platform. Brad also created VINDecoded, where the app moved from AngularJS/Cordova to a React/TypeScript web app, native Android and iOS apps, and a Node.js/TypeScript API, and Android has 1M+ downloads (4.5 stars) and iOS has 400K+ (4.7 stars).

cases.title: “Ask about this” on the Full-stack tile
cases.question: What has Brad built across the stack?
cases.answer:
Brad has built work across mobile, web, backend and AI. On the mobile side, Lead Android Developer at RealPage included leading Android development across a suite of real-estate management apps. At Hopper, Joined Hopper on Android, then moved to full-stack work across Android, iOS, web front end and backend services, building Android and iOS features in Kotlin and Swift. Brad also co-architected and built RemoteUI, a server-driven UI framework rendered natively with Jetpack Compose and MVVM on Android and SwiftUI on iOS.

On the web and backend side, VINDecoded was re-platformed from AngularJS/Cordova to a React/TypeScript web app, native Android and iOS apps, and a Node.js/TypeScript API backed by SQL, Firebase, Azure and cloud analytics. Brad's One Angular game runs on the web and inside native Android (WebView) and iOS (WKWebView) apps, on a Firebase backend. Brad also co-developed Scala services and partner API contracts at Hopper.

On AI, Shipped production AI features: grounded streaming vehicle chat, with provider-switchable models and tool-isolated vehicle data; vision-based VIN, plate and gas-receipt scanning with structured outputs.

cases.title: “Ask about this” on the Applied AI tile
cases.question: What AI work has Brad shipped?
cases.answer: Brad has shipped several AI features. At Hopper, Brad worked directly with the CEO, revenue leaders and the Fintech VP to launch a flight-shopping assistant and generative offers that matched or exceeded static-offer attach rates. At VINDecoded, Brad shipped production AI features: grounded streaming vehicle chat, with provider-switchable models and tool-isolated vehicle data, and vision-based VIN, plate and gas-receipt scanning with structured outputs. Brad also designed human-approved agent workflows for implementation, code review, testing, pull-request preparation, production monitoring and automated error remediation, while keeping architectural and release controls in place.
